source.name: Naga
source.description:
Species Trait: Scale Armor

Active when you have at least (N) different Naga pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Naga: Grants allies 15% magic resistance.
(4) Naga: Grants allies 35% magic resistance.
(6) Naga: When taking non-pure damage, reflect 1.5 times the damage reduced by magic resistance.

source.lore: Nagas are cursed sea-dwellers that haunt the ocean floor. Their hardened, scaly skin acts as an effective defense against spells.
notes: Scale Armors can absorb all kinds of damage(including pure damage).
(6) Nagas detonation has a trigger threshold of 100. Less than 100 absorbed damage will not detonate but accumulate into the next detonation.
